# `testprop` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "testprop" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/testprop/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required |  |
| `name` | string | required | Display name for debug overlays. |
| `mass` | number > 0 | required | Mass in kilograms. |
| `flammable` | boolean | required | World property: fire can ignite it. |
| `tags` | list of string | `[]` | Free-form tags for grey-box scenes. |
| `breaksInto` | ref → testprop | — | Id of the testprop left when this one breaks. |
